name: LiteLLM ships customer spend portal and day-zero models
title: LiteLLM ships customer spend portal and day-zero models
summary: LiteLLM's weekly release adds a beta Customer Portal that attributes traffic and inference spend to each customer, team, and member, and moves /v1/messages fully to Rust. It also adds day-zero routing for Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Mythos 5.2, Gemini 4 Carbon, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, and Gemini Decision 1, plus Replicate video, image, and speech models on OpenAI-style endpoints.
